targets.name: jp-agent-render
targets.notes: The jp-agent runtime behind jaytipargal.tech (owner direction 2026-10-19, D-14). Vercel reaches it through the JP_AGENT_URL environment variable (Backend/agent-run.js), so moving or renaming the service is an environment change, not a code change. Deployed from git; render.yaml declares the service shape. No deploy script, ssh, systemd unit or nginx config exists in this repository. To be filled in from the Render dashboard: the service's public hostname. The service must set JP_AGENT_HOST=0.0.0.0 and mount a disk for JP_AGENT_WORKSPACE.
